blocks.text: Aaiye list par kiye jane wale aam operations (kaam) asal zindagi ki misalon aur Python code se dekhein.
1. Insertion (item dakhil karna)
List mein naya item jorna aisa hai jaise to-do list mein naya kaam likhna. Item list ki alag alag jagahon par dala ja sakta hai. Is ke kuch tareeqe yeh hain:
a. Khaas jagah par dalna: insert() function se item list ki kisi bhi jagah (index) par dala ja sakta hai. insert(0, ...) item ko sab se pehli jagah par dalta hai.

party_list = ["Buy drinks", "Buy decorations", "Buy snacks", "Buy cold drinks "]
party_list.insert(0, "Invite friends")  # add Invite friends at start
print(party_list)
# Output: ['Invite friends', 'Buy drinks', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy snacks', 'Buy cold drinks ']
blocks.caption: Sahi code

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 4 kaamon ki list banti hai. Dhyan dein: "Buy cold drinks " ke aakhir mein ek space hai, woh bhi string ka hissa hai.
"party_list.insert(0, "Invite friends")": insert(index, item) item ko diye gaye index par dalta hai. Index 0 yani sab se pehli jagah; baaqi sab items ek jagah aage khisak jate hain.
"print(party_list)": nayi list dikhata hai.
"# Output: ...": yeh sirf comment hai jo batata hai ke kya aayega; Python ise nahi chalata.
Output: ['Invite friends', 'Buy drinks', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy snacks', 'Buy cold drinks '] — aakhri item mein space bhi dikhti hai.
Khud try karein: insert(0, ...) ko insert(2, ...) kar ke Run karein: ab 'Invite friends' teesri jagah (index 2) par aayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein function ka naam 'insertf()' chhapa hai; sahi naam insert() hai. Kitab ke code mein tirchhe quotes “ ” ’ aur 0 ke baad ek faltu ’ hai, is liye chhapa hua code SyntaxError deta hai. Kitab ka Output comment bhi ghalat hai: us mein "Invite friends" nahi; asal output upar likha hai.
b. Aakhir mein jorna: item ko list ke bilkul aakhir mein jorne ke liye append() function istemal hota hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends", "Buy cold drinks", "Buy decorations", "Buy snacks"]
party_list.append("Order cake")  # Adds 'Order cake' at the end
print(party_list)
# Output: ['Invite friends', 'Buy cold drinks', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy snacks', 'Order cake']
blocks.caption: Sahi code

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 4 kaamon ki list banti hai.
"party_list.append("Order cake")": append hamesha item ko list ke bilkul aakhir mein jorta hai; index batane ki zaroorat nahi.
"print(party_list)": badli hui list dikhata hai.
Output: ['Invite friends', 'Buy cold drinks', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy snacks', 'Order cake'] — 'Order cake' aakhir mein aa gaya.
Khud try karein: ek aur line party_list.append("Buy balloons") print se pehle jor kar Run karein: 'Buy balloons' 'Order cake' ke baad aakhir mein aayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'append!)' chhapa hai; sahi naam append() hai. Kitab ke code mein bhi tirchhe quotes hain (“Invite friends”, "Order cake”), is liye woh SyntaxError deta hai; upar seedhe quotes ke saath sahi code hai.
c. List ko lamba karna (extend): extend() function ek hi baar mein kai items list ke aakhir mein jor deta hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends", "Buy decorations ", "Buy snacks", "Buy cold drinks"]
party_list.extend(["Party hats", "Streamers"])  # Add multiple items at once
print(party_list)
# Output: ['Invite friends', 'Buy decorations ', 'Buy snacks', 'Buy cold drinks', 'Party hats', 'Streamers']
blocks.caption: Sahi code

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 4 kaamon ki list. "Buy decorations " ke aakhir mein ek space hai.
"party_list.extend(["Party hats", "Streamers"])": extend ek poori list ke saare items ek saath aakhir mein jor deta hai. append ek item jorta hai, extend kai items.
"print(party_list)": ab 6 items wali list dikhti hai.
Output: ['Invite friends', 'Buy decorations ', 'Buy snacks', 'Buy cold drinks', 'Party hats', 'Streamers'] — 'Buy decorations ' mein space bhi nazar aati hai.
Khud try karein: extend ki jagah append(["Party hats", "Streamers"]) likh kar Run karein: ab poori list ek hi item ban kar andar jati hai, yani aakhir mein ['Party hats', 'Streamers'] brackets ke saath dikhega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein "Buy snacks” ke aakhir mein tirchha quote ” hai, is liye Python string ka khatma nahi pehchanta aur SyntaxError deta hai.
2. Deletion (item nikalna)
List se item nikalna aisa hai jaise poora ho chuka kaam list se kaat dena. Item nikalne ke kai tareeqe hain:
a. Value se nikalna: remove() function kisi khaas value ko list mein jahan pehli baar mile, wahan se nikal deta hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends ", "Buy decorations", "Buy snacks", "Buy cold drinks"]
party_list.remove("Buy snacks")  # Removes 'Buy snacks' from the list
print(party_list)
# Output: ['Invite friends ', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy cold drinks']
blocks.caption: Sahi code

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 4 kaamon ki list. "Invite friends " ke aakhir mein space hai.
"party_list.remove("Buy snacks")": remove value (qeemat) dekh kar item nikalta hai; jahan "Buy snacks" pehli baar mile wahan se hata deta hai.
"print(party_list)": baaqi 3 items dikhata hai.
Output: ['Invite friends ', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy cold drinks']
Khud try karein: remove("Buy pizza") likh kar Run karein: yeh item list mein nahi, is liye Python ValueError (ghalti) dega. remove sirf maujood item nikal sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein "Buy decorations” aur "Buy snacks” ke aakhir mein tirchhe quotes ” hain, is liye SyntaxError aata hai; upar sahi code hai.
b. Index se nikalna: pop() function kisi khaas index wala item nikal deta hai. pop(0) pehla item nikalta hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends ", "Buy decorations", "Buy cold drinks " ]
party_list.pop (0) # Removes the item at index 0
print(party_list)
# Output: [’Buy decorations’, ’Buy cold drinks’]

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 3 kaamon ki list. "Invite friends " aur "Buy cold drinks " dono ke aakhir mein space hai.
"party_list.pop (0)": pop(index) us index wala item nikalta hai; 0 yani pehla item "Invite friends ". (pop aur ( ke beech space se farq nahi parta, code phir bhi chalta hai.)
"print(party_list)": baaqi list dikhata hai.
Output: ['Buy decorations', 'Buy cold drinks '] — kitab ke comment mein 'Buy cold drinks' bina space ke aur tirchhe quotes mein likha hai, lekin asal output mein aakhri item ke saath space aati hai kyun ke list mein wohi likha hai.
Khud try karein: pop (0) ko pop() kar ke Run karein: bina index ke pop aakhri item nikalta hai, is liye ['Invite friends ', 'Buy decorations'] bachega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein function ka naam 'popO' chhapa hai; sahi naam pop() hai, jaisa code mein hai.
c. Saare items nikalna: clear() function list ke tamam items nikal deta hai aur khali list [] reh jati hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends" , "Buy decorations", "Buy cold drinks " ]
# Removes all items from the list
party_list.clear ()
print(party_list) # Output : []

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 3 kaamon ki list banti hai.
"party_list.clear ()": clear list ke saare items nikal deta hai; list khud baaqi rehti hai lekin khali.
"print(party_list)": khali list dikhata hai. "# Output : []" sirf comment hai.
Output: [] — khali list.
Khud try karein: clear se pehle print(len(party_list)) jor kar Run karein: pehle 3 aayega, phir [].
3. Searching (dhoondna)
List mein item dhoondna aisa hai jaise to-do list mein koi khaas kaam dhoondna. Is ke liye alag alag tareeqe hain:
a. Item hai ya nahi, check karna: 'in' keyword batata hai ke item list mein hai ya nahi. Agar hai to if wala hissa chalta hai, warna else wala.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 3 kaamon ki list banti hai.
"if "Buy cold drinks" in party_list:": in keyword check karta hai ke yeh item list mein hai ya nahi. Agar hai to condition (shart) True hoti hai.
"print("Buy cold drinks is on the list.")": condition True ho to yeh line chalti hai. (Kitab mein is line ka indentation (andar ki taraf jagah) 9 spaces aur else wali line ka 8 hai; Python ko sirf yeh chahiye ke har block ke andar wali lines barabar hon, is liye code theek chalta hai.)
"else:": condition False ho to else ke neeche wali line chalti hai.
Output: Buy cold drinks is on the list. — kyun ke "Buy cold drinks" list mein maujood hai.
Khud try karein: party_list se "Buy cold drinks" hata kar Run karein: ab else wala hissa chalega aur "Buy cold drinks is not on the list." aayega.
b. Index maloom karna: index() function batata hai ke item list mein kis jagah (index) par hai. "Buy decorations" doosri jagah par hai, is liye index 1 hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends", "Buy decorations", "Buy cold drinks " ]
index = party_list.index("Buy decorations") # Finds the position of ’Buy decorations’
print("Index of ’Buy decorations’:", index)
# Output: Index of ’Buy decorations’: 1

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 3 kaamon ki list banti hai.
"index = party_list.index("Buy decorations")": index() batata hai ke item list mein kis jagah par hai. Ginti 0 se shuru hoti hai: "Invite friends" 0, "Buy decorations" 1.
"print("Index of ’Buy decorations’:", index)": label aur mila hua index dikhata hai. Label ke andar tirchhe quotes ’ ’ string ka hissa hain, is liye woh bhi waise hi chhapte hain (koi ghalti nahi, sirf text hai).
Output: Index of ’Buy decorations’: 1
Khud try karein: index("Buy cold drinks") likh kar Run karein: ValueError aayega, kyun ke list mein yeh item aakhir mein space ke saath ("Buy cold drinks ") likha hai, aur string mein ek space ka farq bhi farq hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein function ka naam 'indexO' chhapa hai; sahi naam index() hai, jaisa code mein hai.
Khud chala kar dekhein

Yeh program new_item ko position wale index par insert karta hai aur phir search_item dhoondta hai. position, new_item ya search_item badal kar Run karein; aisa item dhoondein jo list mein nahi, aur dekhein ke else wala hissa chalta hai.

party_list = ["Invite friends", "Buy decorations", "Buy cold drinks"]
new_item = "Order cake"
position = 1       # index where new_item goes
search_item = "Buy cold drinks"

party_list.insert(position, new_item)
print("After insert:", party_list)
if search_item in party_list:
    print(search_item, "is at index", party_list.index(search_item))
else:
    print(search_item, "is not on the list.")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"party_list = [...]": 3 kaamon ki list banti hai.
"new_item = "Order cake"" aur "position = 1": kya dalna hai aur kis index par.
"search_item = "Buy cold drinks"": kaunsa item dhoondna hai.
"party_list.insert(position, new_item)": "Order cake" ko index 1 par dalta hai; baaqi items aage khisak jate hain.
"print("After insert:", party_list)": nayi list dikhata hai.
"if search_item in party_list:": item list mein hai to us ka index chhapta hai (party_list.index se), warna else wala message.
Output: pehli line After insert: ['Invite friends', 'Order cake', 'Buy decorations', 'Buy cold drinks'], doosri line Buy cold drinks is at index 3 — insert ki wajah se "Buy cold drinks" index 2 se 3 par chala gaya.
Khud try karein: search_item = "Buy snacks" kar ke Run karein: yeh list mein nahi, is liye "Buy snacks is not on the list." aayega.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa function list ke aakhir mein item jorta hai (MCQ 1)? List ke saath 'in' keyword kya karta hai (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: (b) append(). (c) 'in' check karta hai ke item list mein hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: extend() function kaise kaam karta hai? Misal dein (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: extend() doosri list (ya sequence) ka har item ek ek kar ke list ke aakhir mein jorta hai: a = [1, 2]; a.extend([3, 4]) ke baad a = [1, 2, 3, 4]. Is ke ulat, a.append([3, 4]) poori list ko ek hi item bana kar jorta hai: [1, 2, [3, 4]].

blocks.prompt: Jab do variables ek hi list ko reference (ishara) karein to kya masla ho sakta hai? Misal dein (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: b = a list ki copy nahi banata; dono naam ek hi list ko dekhte hain. Ek naam se tabdeeli doosre mein bhi nazar aati hai: a = [1, 2]; b = a; b.append(3) ke baad a bhi [1, 2, 3] ho jata hai. Is se aise bugs (ghaltiyan) ban sakte hain jin ki umeed na ho. Alag copy ke liye b = a.copy() ya b = list(a) likhein. (Yeh baat chapter mein nahi likhi; yeh Python ki aam baat hai.)

blocks.prompt: Long question 2: tasks = [design, development, testing, deployment] se shuru karein. Aakhir mein 'review' jorein, teesri jagah 'planning' dalein, 'testing' ko 'quality assurance' se badlein, 'development' value se nikalein, index 1 wala kaam nikalein, 'deployment' ka index print karein, aakhri list aur kaamon ki ginti (count) print karein.
blocks.explanation: tasks.append("review"); tasks.insert(2, "planning"); tasks[tasks.index("testing")] = "quality assurance"; tasks.remove("development"); tasks.pop(1) 'planning' nikalta hai; print(tasks.index("deployment")) 2 dikhata hai; print(tasks) ['design', 'quality assurance', 'deployment', 'review'] dikhata hai; print(len(tasks)) 4 dikhata hai. (Python 3.13 mein chala kar check kiya gaya.)

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Dalna: insert(), append(), extend(); nikalna: remove(), pop(), clear(); dhoondna: in, index().
Code mein hamesha seedhe quotes " ya ' istemal karein.
